summary: Flute: lofi, trap and jazz melodies, airy
label: flute
body: A sparse melody on top; trap uses short flute loops. Pan flute: GeneralUser GS/Pan Flute.

Register: MIDI 60-96 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: GeneralUser GS/Flute, a sampled instrument: make_instrument (sound "GeneralUser GS/Flute") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
